description: Land Title Settlement Department - Etamurungagoda, Harispattuwa D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320315 (23/0353)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including details about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and legal status. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land registration and property ownership matters, which aligns perfectly with the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
